heading: Supreme Petrochem Q2 FY27 Results: Decoding the Dividend and Financial Performance
tldr: Supreme Petrochem has announced a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for the financial year 2026-27.
The company's revenue for Q2 FY27 surged by 77.8% year-on-year, reaching ₹1,956.7 crore.
Profit After Tax (PAT) for the same quarter nearly doubled, amounting to ₹94.9 crore.
October 30 has been fixed as the record date for this interim dividend, impacting who receives the payout.
These results reflect a strong operational performance in the quarter for the petrochemical manufacturer.
caption:
Good news for investors! Supreme Petrochem just announced a dividend of ₹2.50 per share. This means a little extra cash in your pocket if you own their shares by October 30. Their latest results show the company's sales went up a lot, and their profits nearly doubled. This is a strong sign of good performance. Want to know more about what this means?
